# firezone_site (Resource)

A Site - a logical grouping of Gateways and the Resources they expose.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "firezone_site" "main" {
  name = "primary-dc"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Site name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Site ID.
